summary: WF International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held on April 30, 2026. Shareholders re-elected five directors, approved a three-step share consolidation (first 10:1, then 5:1, then 5:1) to reduce outstanding shares and increase par value, adopted a 2026 equity incentive plan, and ratified the appointment of ZH CPA, LLC as auditor. The share consolidation is a capital reorganization, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is present. This is a routine current report of an ordinary shareholder meeting with standard proposals.
